descriptions.preferred: Like other members of the Ghost series, this worthwhile Oregon selection has netted leaves. The medium-large leaves have seven deeply divided narrow curved lobes, with large sharply hooked teeth on the margins, and long tail-like tips. The leaves have a conspicuous network of green veins on a whitishcream background, and look quite ghostly in a shady background. It is estimated this small bushy tree will eventually reach 13 ft. (4 m) tall. It needs some protection from the afternoon sun.

sources.title: 姐妹精灵 Acer Palmatum 'Sister Ghost'
sources.description: 姐妹精灵又称为女精灵、姐妹鬼或女鬼，是由巴克霍兹选育和推广的鬼系品种，也是经典的脉叶品种之一。 叶子上带有明显的脉络，一般为 7裂，叶裂深至基部，叶边缘呈锯齿状。 女精灵春天叶片为明亮的黄绿色，夏季是奶油绿，秋天是金黄色的，也会出现橙红色。 因长势好，抗性强，脉纹清晰，色彩丰富多变等优势深受枫友喜爱。 成年树高约为4米，夏季午后需要适当遮阴。 姐妹精灵属于 精灵 系列 ，此系列还有以下品种点击查看

descriptions_zh.preferred: 与其他 Ghost 系列成员一样，这个来自俄勒冈的优良选育品种具有网脉状叶面。 中大型叶片有 7 个深裂的狭长弯曲裂片，边缘具大而锐利、呈钩状的齿，裂片末端带有细长尾尖。 叶片以白奶油色为底，其上分布清晰的绿色叶脉网络，在荫蔽背景下颇具“幽灵”般的观感。 预计这株小型、枝叶繁密的树最终可长至 13 英尺（4 米）高。 下午强光时需要适当遮护。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Sister Ghost' Rare Sister Ghost Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 In the fall, 'Sister Ghost' turns to a bright golden yellow and, in some years, it becomes infused with orange. 'Sister Ghost' may reach up to 8-10 ft in height and width in 15 years. For best colors on this 'Sister Ghost' Japanese maple, we recommend protection from the hot afternoon sun. This maple is highly prized by collectors because it produces a light wave of color, so get yours before we are sold out. It comes into its true glory during the autumn months, when it's time to reap the rewards of this hardy and resilient cultivar. It will bring a spectacular splash of color to your garden that you're sure to relish for many years to come.
